annotations.title: Check the EU Register of health claims

description: Look up a nutrient/substance in the official EU Register of nutrition and health claims (European Commission data, refreshed weekly). Shows whether each claim is Authorised, Non-authorised or Revoked, its conditions of use, the EFSA question and the legal act.

claim_text.description: Optional words of the claim/function, e.g. "immune system".

substance.description: Nutrient or substance (English or Latin), e.g. "vitamin C", "glucomannan".
